description_en: Retrieves a list of diagnostic history records
description_zh: 获取诊断历史记录列表
kebab_example: aliyun sysom list-diagnosis --current 1 --page-size 10 --service-name memgraph --params key_:_region_,_value_:_cn-beijing --status Running --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDiagnosis

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The diagnostic parameters. Different diagnostic types require different diagnostic parameters. You can use this field to filter records whose parameters match the specified values
parameters.help_zh: 诊断参数，不同类型的诊断要求传递不同的诊断参数，可以使用本字段过滤出参数符合为指定值的记录
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en:
The execution status of the diagnostic task.

Valid values:
Ready: Ready.
Running: Running.
Success: Succeeded.
Fail: Failed
parameters.help_zh:
诊断任务执行状态。
取值：
Ready：就绪
Running：正在执行
Success：执行成功
Fail：执行失败
parameters.name: status

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used for end-to-end diagnostics
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，可用于全链路诊断

code.description_en:
The status code.
`code == Success` indicates that the authorization is successful.
Other status codes indicate authorization failed. Check the `message` field for the detailed fault information
code.description_zh:
状态码
`code == Success` 则代表授权成功；
其它状态码代表授权失败，授权失败时查看 `message` 字段获取详细的错误信息；

items.description_en: The object returned for a single analysis record
items.description_zh: 一条分析记录的返回对象

code.description_en: The diagnostic error code. A value of 0 indicates no error
code.description_zh: 诊断错误码，0代表没有错误

status.description_en:
The execution status of the diagnostic task.

Valid values:
Ready: Ready.
Running: Running.
Success: Succeeded.
Fail: Failed
status.description_zh:
诊断任务执行状态。
取值：
Ready：就绪
Running：正在执行
Success：执行成功
Fail：执行失败

url.description_en: The URL of the diagnostic details

message.description_en:
The error message.
If `code == Success`, this field is empty.
Otherwise, this field contains the request error message
message.description_zh:
错误信息
如果 `code == Success`，则本字段为空；
否则本字段包含请求错误信息
message.example: SysomOpenAPIAssumeRoleException: EntityNotExist.Role The role not exists: acs:ram::xxxxx:role/aliyunserviceroleforsysom
message.title_en: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
message.title_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
